name: fixly-vscode
description: Scan your project's npm dependencies for known vulnerabilities (OSV).

fixly.scanOnSave.description: Automatically rescan when package.json or package-lock.json changes — editor saves and external writes alike (e.g. npm install updating the lock file).

fixly.scanOnType.description: Rescan as you type in package.json, using the unsaved editor contents (debounced). The saved package-lock.json is still used for the dependency tree.

fixly.includeTransitive.description: Also scan transitive dependencies discovered in the package-lock.json tree.

fixly.nvdApiKey.markdownDescription: Optional [NVD API key](https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key). NVD's public rate limit (5 requests / 30s) means only a few CVEs are cross-referenced per scan; a key raises the limit so more findings get NVD's independent CVSS score. Leave blank to use an `NVD_API_KEY` environment variable instead.
